title: Coherence of the explicit cofree evaluation transitions
statement: Let $I$ be a small category in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and $D$ a coherent diagram of sites [def-per-coherent-site-diagram]. Let $Q_a\dashv P_a$ be the actual abelian inverse and direct images with their canonical mate comparisons [def-per-varying-site-abelian-systems], and assume each $Q_a$ additive. Fix $i\in I$ and $A\in\operatorname{Ab}(D_i)$. Put $R_j=\prod_{t:i\to j}P_tA$, with projections $\rho_t$. For $c:k\to j$ define $\sigma_c:Q_cR_j\to R_k$ as the product lift whose $b:i\to k$ factor is $Q_c(\rho_{b\mathbin{\gg}c}\operatorname{comp}_{b,c}^{-1})\varepsilon_c(P_bA)$, in Lean composition order. Then (1) $\sigma_{1_j}$ is the inverse-image unitor on $R_j$; (2) $\operatorname{comp}_{a,b}(R_l)\sigma_{a\mathbin{\gg}b}=Q_a(\sigma_b)\sigma_a$; (3) the adjunct of $\operatorname{unit}_i(X)h$ followed by the direct-image unitor on $A$ equals $h$, for every $X\in\operatorname{Ab}(D_i)$ and $h:X\to A$; (4) the adjunct under $Q_a\dashv P_a$ of $\sigma_a\rho_{1_i}\operatorname{unit}^{P}_i(A)$ is $\rho_a$, for every $a:i\to j$; (5) for every abelian system $X$ and $h:X_i\to A$, the family $q_j:X_j\to R_j$ whose $a$-factor is the adjunct of $X.\phi_a h$ satisfies $Q_c(q_j)\sigma_c=X.\phi_c q_k$. Products are those of [def-weil-category-product]. No inverse image is required to preserve them.

proof.text: Transpose sigma_c to t_c:R_j -> P_c R_k. Counit naturality and the triangle identities identify its mapped b-projection with rho_(b≫c) followed by the inverse direct-image compositor. Right adjoints preserve products, so these projections detect equality.

Test the identity and cocycle of t on all mapped projections. The labels agree by associativity and the comparison maps by the direct-image pseudofunctor triangles and pentagon. Transpose back by the composite Hom bijection to obtain clauses (1)-(2).

The inverse-image unitor is the mate of the direct-image unitor: the identity-arrow adjunct followed by the latter is h. The identity-factor projection of t_a, followed by P_a of that unitor, is rho_a by the direct-image unit triangle. These are clauses (3)-(4).

Transpose the cocycle for X. For the family q, both sides of its compatibility equation have the same b-factor by the transposed cocycle and naturality of adjuncts after h. Product uniqueness, then transposition, yields clause (5).

In the inherited refinement through the punctual/completion and derived-sections continuity tools, this is the free/cofree evaluation input for compatible varying-site resolutions. Here: the cofree arrow-indexed transition construction and its coherence checks.

lean.statement: theorem abelianCofreeEvaluation_coherence [∀ (j k : I) (a : j ⟶ k), (D.abelianInverse a).Additive] (i : I) (A : D.abelianFibre i) : (∀ j : I, D.abelianCofreeTransition i A (𝟙 j) = (D.abelianInverseId j).hom.app (D.abelianCofreeFamily i A j)) ∧ (∀ {j k l : I} (a : j ⟶ k) (b : k ⟶ l), (D.abelianInverseComp a b).hom.app (D.abelianCofreeFamily i A l) ≫ D.abelianCofreeTransition i A (a ≫ b) = (D.abelianInverse a).map (D.abelianCofreeTransition i A b) ≫ D.abelianCofreeTransition i A a) ∧ (∀ (X : D.abelianFibre i) (h : X ⟶ A), (D.abelianAdjunction (𝟙 i)).homEquiv X A ((D.abelianInverseId i).hom.app X ≫ h) ≫ (D.abelianDirectId i).hom.app A = h) ∧ (∀ (j : I) (a : i ⟶ j), (D.abelianAdjunction a).homEquiv (D.abelianCofreeFamily i A j) A (D.abelianCofreeTransition i A a ≫ Pi.π (fun t : i ⟶ i ↦ (D.abelianDirect t).obj A) (𝟙 i) ≫ (D.abelianDirectId i).hom.app A) = Pi.π (fun t : i ⟶ j ↦ (D.abelianDirect t).obj A) a) ∧ (∀ (X : D.AbelianSystem) (h : X.obj i ⟶ A) {j k : I} (c : k ⟶ j), (D.abelianInverse c).map (D.abelianCofreeExtension i X A h j) ≫ D.abelianCofreeTransition i A c = X.transition c ≫ D.abelianCofreeExtension i X A h k)
